current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-05 whole supplied edition; exact native routes in local assessment
current_accepted_append.observation: U011:P1026–1036: he orders release of Small after coercive restraint. U011:P1311–1318: he questions Taylor/Keith, identifies probable curse and tries to find Kazuma. U012:P0611–0629: he could evade alone but redirects fire away from Leen at real bodily cost; also searches for the child despite ostracism.
current_accepted_append.implication: Retain actual particular protection and a serious adverse delay; do not repair the previous direct-contrary findings.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: U011:P1200–1203/1319–1321: he and Leen choose to wait, citing food work and lack of visible mistreatment even after probable coercion is understood. Coercive danger does not require bodily injury, and that rationale must not erase the delay. Earlier information collection, unlocated Kazuma and guarded access are real limits; food subsistence is not automatically dispensable leisure. The strongest rescue scene lacks a competing leisure opportunity; the delay has actual information-seeking and no fully depicted choice of dispensable pleasure over understood available protective means. Keep this as partial comparability, not a bodily-danger exclusion or exoneration. Child-search risk is appraised differently because he knows her capacity. Mixed motives, jokes, eventual recovery, missing completed injury and later charm explanation are not exemptions. Partial new evidence, no full newly scored leisure trial. Dust03 direct contrary and the additive Dust04 coercive-wager direct contrary remain current; full protective-override generalization remains rejected.

current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-05 whole supplied edition; exact native routes in local assessment
current_accepted_append.observation: U011:P1338–1340: her worried face is one reason he commits to action. U012:P0611–0619: restored Dust sees Leen cannot simply evade, chooses the fire-intercepting angle and bears burns.
current_accepted_append.implication: Preserve a real Dust-to-Leen protective choice and attention to her distress, without inventing another completed gift.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: His immediately useful body/position/time have personal cost, but this is urgent protection with no independently elaborated object/gift-retention valuation. Rumor work is also prepaid, for his own town/child/friends and shared interests. Clothing money and necklace are for the child, not Leen; her earlier cooking or care cannot be reversed in direction. Do not require pure motive, yet distinguish useful help from a clean repeat of the original resource-gift situation. Confused knight speech before the headbutt mistakes Leen for princess; later restored protection is not the same mental state. Her secrecy, jealousy and his stare do not complete mutual confession. Partial qualified support for particular care; not a new fully comparable material-gift trial or settled romance. No actual adequate repeated refusal series under identical recognized need is depicted.

Partial contextual support and factual missingness resolution, no fresh complete weapon-restraint trial or changed frozen model. Full historical identity story, precise earlier Leen witness and external consequences remain open.

current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-05 whole supplied edition; exact native routes in local assessment
current_accepted_append.observation: U010:P0025–0031: ignored delegated negotiation yields actual bag seizure for damages/rental. U011:P0834–0848: desired extra money is exposed as task prepayment, then he asks about refusal and expressly limits assent to hearing.
current_accepted_append.implication: Downgrade any universal underchecking formulation; separate ignored delegated obligations, actual checks and knowingly misleading accounting.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: U012:P0393–0400: he hears and accepts the specific whispered divination condition before use; U012:P0694–0696 discloses actual hair/nail payment. Reader withholding is not actor underchecking. Clothing is paid, necklace only promised, credit negotiation only prospective; rumor advance actually received/allocated. The prepaid-task surprise is an initial reward misclassification, but immediate explicit checking is adverse to the mechanism and must count. Prior commission term inattention supports a bounded risk, not every deal failing. Lying about a paid fee or extracting another's material without shown assent is not unnoticed usability. End menu settlement is not printed. Mixed qualitative assessment with real checking counterevidence; no automatic failure rate or invented account repairs. Carry transaction-stage distinctions into later sources.

current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-05 whole supplied edition; exact native routes in local assessment
current_accepted_append.observation: U010:P0345–0366: Small recognizes pride bait/refuses then independently pursues her own Vanir aim. U011:P0968–0981: she refuses even Vanir's feared task. U012:P0043–0065: she initially objects to maligning an unknown person; business rivalry changes cooperation.
current_accepted_append.implication: Strengthen the actual owned-refusal boundary while preserving coercive failures of Dust's respect.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: U011:P1023–1036: Cecily's actual grab and release command are compulsion, not consent. U012:P0403–0420: Dust grabs her, asks Vanir's permission, ignores her manners objection and physically leads her; manager instruction/devotion and roleplay do not establish free unbounded assent. Praise is not isolated experimentally and later cooperation responds to fabricated disrespect/material customer loss. Explicit refusal to an admired manager is strong counterevidence to global compliance; her subsequent useful flight/search role is actual. The child-hat gift is her own act, not blanket service access. Bounded agency supported at actual owned-veto scenes. Physical pressure, fear, client incentives and manager devotion remain separate, adverse to treating all help as freely chosen.

current_accepted_append.implication: Retain changes of information, distribution, formation and angle; evaluate completed execution separately.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Mandragora return is accepted/paid at U011:P1130–1158 but forest stock/victim cure not shown; the child later eats remaining dumped stock. Rumor success co-occurs with Kazuma's independent actions, exact causal share unisolated. Search initially fails, price extracts valuable child material, Small's recruitment uses force. No invented ethical-approval conjunct: coercive tactic can still be a rearrangement attempt, with harm retained. Vanir price and party/Yun acceptance are known; manager permission is not Small's own assent. Final strength depends on reciprocal contract/proximity, not unsupported class superiority; direct blow also has changed geometry. Bounded qualitative support, no safe-total-recovery claim, isolated tactic efficacy estimate or new score. Actual costs and earlier failures remain part of competence.

current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-05 whole supplied edition; exact native routes in local assessment
current_accepted_append.observation: U010:P0205–0278: request becomes romance/marriage, then actual trial and attraction incentives correct it. U010:P0345–0400: pride bait fails and Small's actual matchmaking purpose surprises him. U011:P0627 onward: he underestimates child-care/food costs, later corrects after actual depletion.
current_accepted_append.implication: Keep appetite-compatible guesses, actual updates, deliberate lies and altered-state errors separate.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: U011:P1311–1314: direct fixed replies plus past experience ground a curse hypothesis; U012:P0094–0102: Yun's unaffected conversation rules out universal automatic conversion. U012:P0493–0497: bitten dumped stock plus linked symptoms lead to supported mandragora connection, corroborated by child's report at0625. His knowledge of child capacity makes initial low fear different from ordinary-child neglect inference, but lack of attention is actually acknowledged. Serena's eventual exposure does not validate flawed priest-looking suspicious induction. Confused princess identification is bodily/linked-state error, not a clean ordinary-social trial. Epilogue and late reported mechanism are unavailable earlier. Bounded supported tendency with substantial competent counterexamples and updating; no global unreliable/infallible narrator label or durable cure from this volume.
